rows.grounds: compound denoting contrasting flavors; internal sandhi in fused form

items.question: What prevents beings lacking vital awareness from discerning experiential qualities?
premises: The dead lack the capacity for sensory experience.
Taste distinguishes qualities such as pungent and sweet.
Without vital awareness, such distinctions cannot be known.
items.inference: Absence of vital awareness entails inability to apprehend experiential distinctions.
uncertainties: The intended analogical target of the dead is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Just as the dead do not know the taste of what is pungent and sweet, so those without vital awareness cannot discern such qualities.
